name: 背景に重ねたメンバーの公開プロフィール
prompt:
Faithfully recreate only the Japanese public-profile card shown in the primary native preview. Use an exact 390x316 white canvas and preserve its calm compact layout, colors, positions and Japanese text. This is a reference reconstruction, not a redesign.

The top 138px is a solid deep forest-green background. Below it, use the plain white profile area. Place a large pale-mint circular avatar overlapping the green/white boundary at x18,y103, about 86px in diameter, with the dark forest-green Japanese initial 「山」 centered inside. Place the exact bold dark display name 「山田 はるか」 at x18 near y208. Under it, show the exact quiet gray line 「やまだ・はるか ・ 呼称：彼女」 near y244. Near the lower left, place the small forest-green mutual-groups icon, then the exact muted-gray label 「共通のグループ 1件」 on the same line. Preserve the compact spacing and generous white area; do not add cards, borders or shadows.

The original profile screenshot is context only. Keep the Japanese native preview as the exact authority. Do not copy the source photograph, online-status dot, kebab menu, English handle, pronouns, PXL badge or source background. The PXL label is a badge, not a hyperlink. This selected component contains no hyperlink text, so keep all text in its native dark/gray colors and do not add blue text.
reviewNotes: Compared side by side with the native 390x316 preview. Header split, avatar, Japanese name/subtitle, and muted mutual-groups label closely match. The group icon lost its native mint rounded-square tile, so a focused second attempt is needed. No hyperlink is present; all text stays dark or gray.
